landing.metaTitle: Bazarga · Your store, in your language
landing.metaDescription: A Kurdish-first online store for Instagram and WhatsApp sellers. Send photos and prices, get a store with delivery per city and local payments.
landing.heroSub: Send photos and prices in your language. Your store goes live. No themes, no dashboard.
landing.heroAlt: A Kurdish shop owner photographing a scarf with her phone
landing.howTitle: Three steps, all in a chat.
landing.s1Title: Send photos and prices in chat
landing.s1Body: On WhatsApp or Instagram, just like you'd send them to a friend.
landing.s2Body: Names, prices, photos and a delivery fee for every city. You set up nothing.
landing.s3Title: Share the link on Instagram and WhatsApp
landing.s3Body: Orders come in, and you get paid cash on delivery.
landing.demoTitle: A store like this, only yours.
landing.demoBody: Hawler Bazaar is a real working store on Bazarga. Add something to the cart, pick your city and see the delivery fee.
landing.whyTitle: Built for the bazaar right here.
landing.w1Body: Sorani and Kurmanji built in. Rivals lead in Arabic.
landing.w2Body: A chat with photos is enough.
landing.w3Body: Cash on delivery, FIB, ZainCash, FastPay and Qi, with delivery priced per city.
landing.w4Body: Diaspora shops in Germany, Turkmen and Assyrian sellers.
landing.whoTitle: Anyone selling on Instagram and WhatsApp.
landing.formError: Please fill in your name, WhatsApp number, what you sell and your city.

auth.signupSub: Free to start. Takes a minute.
auth.name: Your name
auth.forgotSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.

onboarding.title: Let's set up your store
onboarding.sub: You can change all of this later.
onboarding.whatsappHint: Customers message you here after ordering

setup.title: Set up your store
setup.subtitle: A few steps and your store is ready for its first order.

logo.title: Add your logo
logo.desc: Shoppers trust a store with a face. Upload your logo or brand photo.

product.title: Add your first product
product.desc: A photo, a name and a price is enough to start.

delivery.title: Check your delivery fees
delivery.desc: We filled in a fee for every city. Change them or add your own areas.

whatsapp.title: Add your WhatsApp number
whatsapp.desc: Orders and customer questions reach you on WhatsApp.

share.title: Share your store link
share.desc: Put it in your Instagram bio and WhatsApp status.

products.title: Products
products.name: Name
products.compareAtHint: Set it above the price to put the product on sale: it shows crossed out with a −% badge and appears under Offers. Leave empty if none.
products.stockHint: Leave empty if you don't count stock
products.imagesHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB each
products.translations: Name and description in each language
products.translationsHint: Fill at least one. Missing languages fall back automatically.
products.skuHint: Your own product code, e.g. HB-HONEY-500
products.specsHint: Material, size, weight, origin… shown as a table on the product page. Fill each row in the language tab you're on.
products.specsInvalid: Every row needs a label and a value.
products.badgeHint: Shown on the product photo in your store. "Best seller" is added automatically from your orders.

delivery.title: Delivery fees
delivery.sub: What customers pay for delivery, per city.
delivery.areasHint: Neighbourhoods or towns shoppers can pick. Leave the fee empty to use the city fee.
delivery.noAreas: No areas yet — shoppers just type theirs.

payments.title: Payment methods
payments.sub: Choose how customers can pay you.
payments.notConfigured: Not connected on this server yet — customers won't see it until it is.

orders.title: Orders
orders.confirmBody_cancelled: Tracked stock goes back to your products. This can't be undone.
orders.confirmBody_returned: The parcel is back with you. Tracked stock goes back to your products. This can't be undone.
orders.confirmBody_refused: The customer refused the parcel. When it is back with you, mark it returned to put the stock back.
orders.trackingLinkHint: Send it to the customer: they enter their phone number to see the order.
orders.slipHint: Pick A6 or A5 paper in the print dialog.

customers.title: Customers
customers.empty: Customers appear here after their first order.
customers.name: Name

settings.title: Store settings
settings.tagline: Short line under your store name
settings.danger: Your store link changes if you change it here.
settings.themeHint: Pick a style for your storefront. You can change it any time.
settings.accentHint: Buttons and highlights. Leave empty to use the style's colour.
settings.coverHint: A wide photo across the top of your store. JPG, PNG or WebP.
settings.freeDeliveryHint: Orders at or above this amount ship free. Leave empty to turn it off.

ai.title: Add products from photos
ai.sub: Upload photos and write what they are and their prices in any language. We'll draft the products — you check and confirm.
ai.messagePlaceholder: e.g. کراسی کوردی ٨٥ هەزار، هەنگوینی چیا ٢٥ هەزار
ai.disabled: Photo-to-product is not switched on for this server yet.

shareKit.title: Share kit
shareKit.subtitle: Everything you need to bring shoppers to your store.

🛍️ Order online, pay cash on delivery 👇
{url}
shareKit.qrHint: Print it on bags, receipts and your shop counter. Customers scan it to open your store.
shareKit.storyHint: A ready-made 1080×1920 story with your logo, name and QR code. Post it and add a link sticker to your store.

risk.title: Check before shipping
risk.hint: These are signs of a possible fake order. Call the customer to confirm before you send it.
risk.flag_fast_submit: The order form was filled in unusually fast.
risk.flag_duplicate: The same phone ordered the same items in the last 24 hours.
risk.flag_many_open: This phone has other orders still open.
risk.flag_refused_before: This phone refused or returned an order before.
risk.blocked: This number is blocked: new orders from it are refused.
risk.blockConfirm: Block {phone}? New orders from this number will be refused at checkout.
risk.listHint: Orders from these numbers are refused with a polite message. Only your store is affected.

analytics.subtitle: How shoppers find and buy from your store.
analytics.empty: No data yet. Share your store link to get your first visitors.
analytics.privacy: Counted on our own servers, without cookies or third-party trackers. Bots and link previews are not counted; each visitor counts once per page per day.
analytics.ordersNote: Cancelled, refused and returned orders are left out.
